title: Strategies for Antiplatelet Management followIng acute coronary syndrome
official: STRategiEs for Antiplatelet Management foLlowIng acute coroNary syndromE (STREAMLINE)
summary: Main objective: Incidence of the composite “all-cause mortality, non-fatal MI or stroke” at 12 months follow up
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Patients who are ≥18 years
2. Admitted because of an acute MI (either STEMI or NSTEMI)
3. Invasive management during index admission with successful PCI (with either stent (any) or balloon (any, including drug coated balloon)).
4. Able to consent
Exclusion criteria:
1. Indication for long term oral anticoagulation therapy
2. Planned elective surgery at the time of randomization requiring interruption of potent P2Y12i during the following 12 months
3. Any medical condition that, in the investigator´s judgment, would seriously limit life expectancy (less than one year)
4. Current enrolment in other clinical trials.
5. Intolerance, contraindication or known allergy to either aspirin, ticagrelor or prasugrel.
6. Prior history of ischaemic or haemorrhagic stroke or transient ischaemic attack
7. Patients with active bleeding or known severe bleeding disorders
8. Patients with known moderate or severe hepatic dysfunction (Child-Pugh class B or C).
9. Known intracranial aneurism, arteriovenous malformation or neoplasm
10. Patients with chronic kidney disease requiring dialysis
11. Women that are pregnant, breast feeding or with childbearing potential
12. Concomitant use of CYP3A inhibitors or inducers
